steps.aria:
- main:
  - heading "Hand off the jobs you do every week." [level=1]
  - paragraph: Pick one below or describe it. Foundry builds it, tests it with pretend data, and shows you exactly what it will do. Nothing real happens until you say yes.
  - paragraph:
    - link "Your automations (1)":
      - /url: "#/automations"
  - heading "Foundry can make these today" [level=2]
  - list "Foundry can make these today":
    - listitem "Chase unpaid invoices":
      - heading "Chase unpaid invoices" [level=3]
      - paragraph: Polite reminders to customers who are late, firmer later. You see every e-mail first.
      - list "About this automation":
        - listitem: "Uses AI: no"
        - listitem: "Needs: your invoice list as a spreadsheet"
      - link "Start":
        - /url: "#/make/invoice-chase"
    - listitem "Approve small expenses":
      - heading "Approve small expenses" [level=3]
      - paragraph: Approves claims under your limit. Sends the rest to the person who decides.
      - list "About this automation":
        - listitem: "Uses AI: no"
        - listitem: "Needs: your expense claims as a spreadsheet"
      - link "Start":
        - /url: "#/make/expense-approval"
    - listitem "Weekly progress report":
      - heading "Weekly progress report" [level=3]
      - paragraph: Counts what's done, open and blocked, and e-mails one person.
      - list "About this automation":
        - listitem: "Uses AI: no"
        - listitem: "Needs: your tracker export as a spreadsheet"
      - link "Start":
        - /url: "#/make/weekly-report"
    - listitem "Route new leads":
      - heading "Route new leads" [level=3]
      - paragraph: Sends each new lead to the right salesperson.
      - list "About this automation":
        - listitem: "Uses AI: no"
        - listitem: "Needs: your leads list as a spreadsheet"
      - link "Start":
        - /url: "#/make/lead-triage"
    - listitem "Answer common support questions":
      - heading "Answer common support questions" [level=3]
      - paragraph: Replies with your own answers. Sends the rest to a person.
      - list "About this automation":
        - listitem: "Uses AI: no"
        - listitem: "Needs: your ticket export as a spreadsheet"
      - link "Start":
        - /url: "#/make/support-deflection"
    - listitem "On-call alert digest":
      - heading "On-call alert digest" [level=3]
      - paragraph: One summary of unresolved alerts to a chat channel.
      - list "About this automation":
        - listitem: "Uses AI: no"
        - listitem: "Needs: your alerts export as a spreadsheet"
      - link "Start":
        - /url: "#/make/oncall-digest"
    - listitem "Keep the newsletter list in step":
      - heading "Keep the newsletter list in step" [level=3]
      - paragraph: Finds contacts missing from your list and tells you.
      - list "About this automation":
        - listitem: "Uses AI: no"
        - listitem: "Needs: your customer list (CRM export) and newsletter list as a spreadsheet"
      - link "Start":
        - /url: "#/make/contact-sync"
  - search "Or describe it in your own words":
    - text: Or describe it in your own words
    - textbox "Or describe it in your own words":
      - /placeholder: e.g. remind customers who haven't paid after a week
    - button "Find a match"
    - paragraph: Without an AI key, Foundry matches your words to the list above. Nothing leaves this computer.
  - paragraph: "Already use n8n? Drop an exported workflow to see what it does and what could come over. Zapier and Make: later."
  - text: Preview
  - link "Bring in an n8n workflow":
    - /url: "#/import"
  - paragraph:
    - text: Use Claude Code, Cursor or Codex?
    - link "Connect it with one line →":
      - /url: "#/connect-agent"
  - paragraph:
    - text: "Runs on this computer. No account. Nothing runs, sends or changes until you say yes. The limit: a coding agent that can run commands as you on this computer could do what you can do, including say yes."
    - 'link "Where this comes from: Nothing happens until you say yes (with one honest limit)"':
      - /url: "#/claims?c=C01"
      - text: (source)
    - link "How this is kept safe":
      - /url: "#/trust"
  - region "Why Foundry tests before it acts":
    - heading "Why Foundry tests before it acts" [level=2]
    - paragraph:
      - text: In our own tests, a low-cost AI that practised first built a 14-case order process with 14 of 14 right, for $0.39. A top AI that built it in one go got 5 of 14, for $7.63.
      - 'link "Where this comes from: Practising first: 14 of 14 versus 5 of 14"':
        - /url: "#/claims?c=C04"
        - text: (source)
    - paragraph: These are development tests on one task family we wrote, not a promise about yours.

- main:
  - heading "Runs" [level=1]
  - paragraph: Every run keeps a chained record. Foundry checks the chain each time you open this page.
  - table "Runs":
    - caption: Runs
    - rowgroup:
      - row "Automation Result When Record":
        - columnheader "Automation"
        - columnheader "Result"
        - columnheader "When"
        - columnheader "Record"
